g.text: Cross-section across a plate margin (not to scale)
The arrows point away from the centre: plates R and S move apart.
Magma rises through the fissure into the central opening, where
The newest crust lies at the centre, with progressively older
crust farther away on both sides: new crust forms at the opening
and moves outward with the separating plates.
Pressure falls as mantle rises beneath the separating plates
(dashed), so some of it partly melts. The margin is constructive
